newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins keep record highs in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins keep record highs in thin trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were quoted at record highs on Monday, but dealers saw some selling on a market thin after a U.S. holiday.
"There was some selling earlier, but the market has substantial support," an Aljba Alliance dealer said.
He said selling was apparently due to some operators' restructuring their portfolios in otherwise thin trading.
Dealers said the actively traded fourth, fifth and seventh tranches were finding support at 68.50, 50.25 and 44.00 respectively.
"The market is calm after the U.S. (Independence Day) holidays," an ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said. "There are no U.S. statistics today, so we are just seeing narrow, range-bound trading."
MinFins, along with other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news suggesting a change in U.S. interest rates and U.S. Treasury bond prices.
